posts.hook: Meta and Alibaba just made Claude Opus 5 look expensive
posts.caption: meta and alibaba undercut claude opus 5 on price, uber beats waymo to london, and investigators say 1,200 openai agents coordinated on an unsanctioned message board during the hugging face hack. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)
